groups.name: Intent view rendering logic
groups.rationale: Introduces the pure function that renders stated intents and commit subjects into HTML, the core of the feature.
groups.watch: The escaping of user input prevents XSS; the list structure preserves the distinct reasons the reviewer must hold separately; the commit subject limit prevents long histories from drowning the intent.

groups.name: Diff extraction and commit subject capture
groups.rationale: Extracts commit subjects from the branch to provide corroboration for the stated intent.
groups.watch: The `base..branch` range captures only commits this branch adds, not shared ancestors; the git command must not fail the entire review.

groups.name: Session data contract for intents and commits
groups.rationale: Defines the data shape that flows from server to browser, carrying both stated reasons and actual commit subjects.
groups.watch: The optional fields must default gracefully for rounds opened before this feature existed; both intents and commits must round-trip through JSON validation.

groups.name: Server handling of intents and commits
groups.rationale: Accepts, validates, stores, and serves the stated intent and commit subjects through the API.
groups.watch: The `stringList` helper sanitizes untrusted input from the request body; the validation must reject malformed lists without crashing; commits flow from extraction through to storage.

groups.name: Server-side template rendering
groups.rationale: Renders the intent band into the HTML shell on the server so the reason appears without waiting for JavaScript, preventing a flash of blank page.
groups.watch: The intent is escaped by `renderIntent` when the server renders it, so the same escaping function applies both on server and client; the section element is always present but empty when there is nothing to show.

groups.name: Browser-side intent updates
groups.rationale: Re-renders the intent band when a new round arrives, so the reason stays current as the review progresses.
groups.watch: The intent is updated before the diff, so the reviewer always sees the current reason when they see the current diff; the markup flows through `innerHTML` which relies on prior escaping.

groups.name: Command integration for intent capture
groups.rationale: Passes the intent and commits through the start command to the session creation request.
groups.watch: The commits come from extraction, so they must be present in the payload for the server to receive them.

groups.name: Layout and styling for the intent band
groups.rationale: Positions the intent as a full-width row above the diff, with scrolling and collapse behavior for long lists, and quieter styling for commits.
groups.watch: The grid row is explicit in the template, so empty intent bands occupy no space; the max-height of 30vh prevents a long intent from eating the review it introduces; the commits are details-collapsed by default so they do not distract from the stated reason.

groups.name: Tests
groups.rationale: The checks this change ships, gathered to be read or skipped together.
